adapter_requirements: Treat context_sha256 as a caller-declared digest of run/config/data/adapter/RQ identities, actual phase/time, event cursor and recovery generation; owner cannot verify the runtime clock.
Validate actual current AND target context at event/query/final cache consumption and recovery entry, including zero-position and empty-universe paths.
Only Jan-03 and Jan-06 may advance native events; Jan-02 warmup and Jan-07 successor are read roles, not extra execution dates.
Successor must be exactly owner next_open, strictly later, n=1, with covered target state; reject RQ tail clamping.
An internal bounded horizon marker is not a real delisting date, an estimate or a bound. Never export it as source data or use it outside reviewed consumers.
Revalidate cached projections against fresh context; reconstruct via public queries on recovery and reject old checkpoint identities. No execution permission is granted.
Unknown/contradictory listing, status, event or rule evidence stops this profile; do not disable native checks. No automatic external evidence monitoring.
